headline: Navjeet Singh Sobti (HUF) files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI takeover regulations
sum: Navjeet Singh Sobti (HUF) has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with the NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material acquisition of shares in Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited.
detail: Navjeet Singh Sobti (HUF) has submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE in compliance with Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Code. Such disclosures are mandatory when a shareholder or acquirer crosses specified thresholds of shareholding. The filing indicates a material change in shareholding in Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited, a financial services company. The specific quantum of shares acquired and the trigger event are detailed in the filed disclosure document.
